question: Is the Liberty Ridge row on Mount Rainier the same climb as 'Liberty Cap via Liberty Ridge' on the Liberty Cap area, i.e. is one climb filed twice?
answer: Yes, one climb is filed twice. Liberty Ridge is the route up the buttress between Willis Wall and Liberty Wall that ends on Liberty Cap (14,112 ft), the northern sub-summit of Rainier. Both rows (wa_mount_rainier_liberty_ridge and wa_liberty_cap_liberty_ridge_finish) give AI3, aspect N, 'between Willis Wall and Liberty Wall', the same White River/Glacier Basin start, the same St. Elmo Pass, Winthrop Glacier, Curtis Ridge, Carbon Glacier approach, the same waypoints (Curtis Ridge camp 46.8937,-121.7680; St. Elmo Pass; Liberty Cap summit 46.8629,-121.7749), the same Emmons descent and the same hazards. The Liberty Cap row has the fuller text (first-ascent history, season May-Jul, month breakdown, Thumb Rock camp at 10,500 ft, Black Pyramid hazard, 30 track pts). The Rainier row has no track and fewer waypoints. The same split also affects Ptarmigan Ridge: wa_mount_rainier_ptarmigan_ridge (alpine 5.6, season May-Jun) and wa_liberty_cap_ptarmigan_ridge_finish (alpine 5.6, May-Jul) are also one climb (same crux chimney, same Liberty Cap top-out). The earlier dupes/same-climb reads do not mention either pair.
recommendation: Merge into ONE row per climb. Keep wa_mount_rainier_liberty_ridge (the name and id are how the route is known, and it sits on Rainier where climbers look) and copy into it the richer Liberty Cap text: season May-Jul, best season and month breakdown, overview history, descent, beta, Thumb Rock / Black Pyramid / Curtis Ridge camp waypoints, and the track points if they are a recorded track. Reconcile gain (11,500 vs 9,700 ft) and distance (16.1 vs 30.3 km) by reading the track. Delete wa_liberty_cap_liberty_ridge_finish afterwards, moving any log or contribution references (route-identity procedure; assert area_id). Do the same for Ptarmigan Ridge: keep wa_mount_rainier_ptarmigan_ridge, merge in the beta of wa_liberty_cap_ptarmigan_ridge_finish (WI3 traverse, 5.6 chimney), delete the Liberty Cap duplicate. Recommendation only; no writes were made.
